topic: Visiting Office Hours to Ask for a Recommendation Letter

script.title: OFFICE HOURS
script.scene_zh: 大學辦公室 · 拜託推薦信
script.story_hook: One nervous student, one deadline, one kind professor.
script.intro_zh: 一個緊張的學生、一個截止日、一位善良的老師。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a professor's office during open hours. Listen for polite request phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到教授開放時間的辦公室。留意禮貌請求的說法。
script.outro: And that is how you ask for a letter. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 請求推薦信就這麼完成了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: That Map Really Impressed the Room
script.char_a_description: a lean young man in his early twenties with short black hair faded at the sides, round wire glasses, an olive green flannel shirt over a plain white tee, a worn backpack on one shoulder
script.char_b_description: a warm older woman in her mid sixties with short curly silver hair, gold reading glasses perched low, a burgundy knit cardigan over a cream blouse, a long scarf, and a slight stooped build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, are these your office hours?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ɑɹ ˈiːz jɔɹ ˈɔfəs aʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 打擾了，請問這是您的辦公時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are, come in. Do I know you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑɹ kʌm ɪn du aɪ ˈnoʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 是的，請進。我認識你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope so! I was in your spring lecture.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp soʊ aɪ wəz ɪn jɔɹ spɹɪŋ ˈlɛktʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 希望還記得！我上過您春季那堂課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lecture... ah, the city water project, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛktʃɚ ɑ ðə ˈsɪɾi ˈwɔɾɚ ˈpɹɑdʒɛkt ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那堂課……啊，是城市水利那個專題，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! That was me, Leo Marchetti. Hi.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt wəz mi ˈlioʊ mɑɹˈkɛɾi haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對！就是我，里歐．馬凱提。您好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I remember that water map. Come, sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɹɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt ˈwɔɾɚ mæp kʌm sɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我想起來了，那張水資源地圖。來，坐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Um, I need a favor, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ʌm aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈfeɪvɚ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。呃，老實說，我想請您幫個忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me guess — recommendation letter?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛs ɹɪˌkɑmənˈdeɪʃən ˈlɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 讓我猜猜——推薦信，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you know? Yes, a master's program.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪdʒə ˈnoʊ jɛs ə ˈmæstɚz ˈproʊɡɹæm/
dialogue.zh: 您怎麼知道？是的，是碩士班申請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get a few of these a semester, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ə fju ʌv ðiz ə ˈsɛməstɚ ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 一學期總有幾個這樣的請求，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that makes me feel less guilty, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt meks mi fil lɛs ˈɡɪɾi hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這樣我就沒那麼內疚了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, which program, and when's the deadline?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɪtʃ ˈproʊɡɹæm ænd wɛnz ðə ˈdɛdˌlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，申請哪個項目？什麼時候截止？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Urban planning up north, due first of December.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜɹbən ˈplænɪŋ ʌp nɔɹθ du fɝst əv dɪˈsɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 北部的都市規劃研究所，十二月一日截止。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: December... that's tight, but doable. I can help.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈsɛmbɚ ðæts taɪt bʌt ˈduəbəl aɪ kən hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 十二月……有點趕，但來得及。我願意幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's wonderful news, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæts ˈwʌndɚfəl nuz θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？太好的消息了，謝謝您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before I promise, what should the letter stress?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ ˈpɹɑmɪs wət ʃʊd ðə ˈlɛɾɚ stɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 在我承諾之前，信裡該強調什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, the project mainly, and how I lead teams.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə ˈpɹɑdʒɛkt ˈmeɪnli ænd haʊ aɪ liːd timz/
dialogue.zh: 呃，主要寫那個專題，還有我帶領團隊的表現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice. That map really impressed the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs ðæt mæp ˈɹɪli ɪmˈpɹɛst ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 選得好。那張地圖真的讓全場眼睛一亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I kept the printed copy, actually, it's in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɛpt ðə ˈpɹɪntəd ˈkɑpi ˈæktʃuəli ɪts ɪn maɪ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 其實我把列印稿留下來了，就在包里。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what serious students do, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wət ˈsɪɹiəs ˈstudənts du aɪ si/
dialogue.zh: 這就是認真學生的做法，我看在眼裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought my resume and a one-page draft list.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt maɪ ˈrɛzʊˌmeɪ ænd ə wʌn peɪdʒ dræft lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 我帶來了簡歷，還有一頁重點草稿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A draft list? You saved your old teacher work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dræft lɪst ju seɪvd jɔɹ ˈoʊld ˈtitʃɚ wɜɹk/
dialogue.zh: 重點草稿？你連老師該想的都幫我想好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I want to make it easy for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ wɑnt tə meɪk ɪt ˈizi fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我就是想讓寫信這件事輕鬆一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So kind. Does the school send you a form?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kaɪnd dʌz ðə skul sɛnd ju ə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 真貼心。學校會寄一份表格過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, an email link should reach you by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ən ˈimeɪl lɪŋk ʃʊd ɹitʃ ju baɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有的，星期五之前會到一個郵件連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I upload everything through that one portal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ ˈʌpˌloʊd ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ θɹu ðæt wʌn ˈpɔɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我都是從那個入口網站上傳資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add my transcript too, or just the resume?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ æd maɪ ˈtɹænskrɪpt tu ɔɹ dʒʌst ðə ˈrɛzʊmeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我要附上成績單嗎，還是只放簡歷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Attach the transcript. Numbers back up my words.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈtætʃ ðə ˈtɹænskrɪpt ˈnʌmbɚz bæk ʌp maɪ wɜɹdz/
dialogue.zh: 附上吧。分數能支持我說的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's saved on my phone already, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts seɪvd ɑn maɪ foʊn ɔlˈrɛdi si/
dialogue.zh: 手機裡已經存好了，您看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Organized. Does this letter support any other application?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɹɡənaɪzd dʌz ðɪs ˈlɛɾɚ səˈpɔɹt ˈɛni ˈæpləˈkeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 真有條理。這封信還要配其他申請嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just this one now, um, maybe three next year.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðɪs wʌn naʊ ʌm ˈmeɪbi θɹi nɛkst jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 目前只有這一個，呃，明年也許還有三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Busy year. Send the resume file tonight, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbizi jɪɹ sɛnd ðə ˈrɛzʊmeɪ faɪl təˈnaɪt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 忙碌的一年。今晚把簡歷檔傳過來，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send it before dinner, it's ready to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ˈdɪnɚ ɪts ˈɛɹi tə ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 晚飯前一定發出去，檔案都準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One favor back: keep our deadline in writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfeɪvɚ bæk kip ˈaʊɚ ˈdɛdˌlaɪn ɪn ˈɹaɪɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我也請你幫個小忙：把截止日白紙黑字記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, calendar note made, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs ˈkælənˌdɛɹ noʊt meɪd dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我現在就記入行事曆，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And don't forget a thank-you to the committee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd doʊnt fɚˈɡɛt ə θæŋk ju tə ðə kəˈmɪɾi/
dialogue.zh: 還有，別忘了向委員會道謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One goes to every program, that's a promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡoʊz tə ˈɛvɹi ˈproʊɡɹæm ðæts ə ˈpɹɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 我答應您，每個單位都會收到一封謝函。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good manners open doors, you'll do fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmænɚz ˈoʊpən dɔɹz jul du faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 禮數會替人開門，你會申請順利的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, professor, may I ask one more thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm pɹəˈfɛsɚ me aɪ æsk wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，教授，我還能再問一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got twenty minutes, go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɡɑ ˈtwɛnɾi ˈmɪnəts ɡoʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 你還有二十分鐘，說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I list you as my main reference?
dialogue.phonetic: /me aɪ lɪst ju æz maɪ meɪn ˈɛfɚəns/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把您列為主要推薦人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, use my university email, not the old one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ juz maɪ ˌjunəˈvɜɹsəɾi ˈimeɪl nɑt ði ˈoʊld wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，填學校信箱，別用那個舊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. And if they ever call you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ænd ɪf ðeɪ ˈɛvɚ kɔl ju/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那萬一他們打電話來問呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them I check messages between two and four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm aɪ tʃɛk ˈmɛsəˌdʒəz bəˈtidʊ tə ænd fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 告訴他們，我都在兩點到四點看訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Between two and four, noted right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈtwɛn tu ænd fɔɹ ˈnoʊɾəd ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 兩點到四點，我現在就記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You remind me why I took this job, Leo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɹɪˈmaɪnd mi waɪ aɪ tʊk ðɪs dʒɑb ˈlioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 里歐，你讓我想起當初為什麼當老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That means a lot coming from you, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ə lɑt ˈkʌmɪŋ fɹʌm ju ˈɹɪli/
dialogue.zh: 這話從您口中說出，意義真的很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send that file tonight and I'll start drafting.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ðæt faɪl təˈnaɪt ænd aɪl stɑɹt ˈdɹæftɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚把檔案傳來，我就開始動筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On its way by eight, I promise. Thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ɪts weɪ baɪ eɪt aɪ ˈpɹɑməs θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 八點前一定送到。謝謝您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My door stays open after class, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dɔɹ steɪz ˈoʊpən ˈæftɚ klæs ju ˈnoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 課後我的門也常開著，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, um, may I bring my cousin next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli ʌm me aɪ bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈkʌzən nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 對了，呃，下週我可以帶表妹一起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring her, applications are scary alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ hɜɹ ˌæpləˈkeɪʃənz ɑɹ ˈskɛɹi əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 帶著她一起來吧，申請季一個人面對很嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll love this, she worries way too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil lʌv ðɪs ʃi ˈwɜɹiz weɪ tu mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 她聽了肯定開心，她總是擔心太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We all did at that age, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɔl dɪd æt ðæt eɪdʒ tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 我們那個年紀都這樣，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I've taken enough of your afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪv ˈteɪkən ɪˈnʌf əv jɔɹ ˌæftɚˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，已經佔用您太多下午時間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nonsense, this was the best hour of my week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɑnsɛns ðɪs wəz ðə bɛst aʊɚ əv maɪ wik/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡的話，這是我這週最開心的一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, truly. I'll email the file right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈtɹuli aɪl ˈimeɪl ðə faɪl ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真心感謝，我現在就去發檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go eat something, grad applicants forget lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ it ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɡɹæd ˈæpləˌkænts fɚˈɡɛt lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 快去吃飯吧，申請研究所的人都常忘了午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, you got me, I skipped breakfast again.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jə ˈɡɑt mi aɪ skɪpt ˈbɹɛkfəst əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，瞞不住您了，我又沒吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By then the letter will shine. See you Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðɛn ðə ˈlɛɾɚ wɪl ʃaɪn si ju ˈmʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 到那時，這封信一定出色。週一見。

script.youtube_description:
「那張地圖讓全場眼睛一亮」——在教授的辦公時間，該怎麼開口拜託一封碩士申請的推薦信？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在大學辦公室的書桌前。

你會聽到：進門寒暄與自我介紹、禮貌提出請求的完整說法、截止日與線上表格的往來、簡歷和成績單要不要附、教授反向請你提醒日期、還有向委員會道謝的小細節。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，夾著美國人口語裡的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、really。聽完你就會用：Are these your office hours?、May I ask one more thing?、I'll send it before dinner、See you Monday。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與開通小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"That map really impressed the room" — how do you ask a professor for a recommendation letter during office hours? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a university desk.

You will hear: walking in and reintroducing yourself, making the polite ask, talking about deadlines and online forms, whether to attach a resume and transcript, and the small thank-you to the committee.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the sounds Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, really. By the end you'll own phrases like Are these your office hours?, May I ask one more thing?, and I'll send it before dinner.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
下週就是截止日，你連「可以請您寫推薦信嗎」都還不敢說出口，怎麼辦？成績單、簡歷、線上表格，到底誰該收什麼？
這一集帶大家走進教授的辦公時間，從開口自我介紹、討論信件重點，一路聽到約好檔案與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🎓 開場自我介紹：I was in your spring lecture. 讓教授想起你是誰。
💌 禮貌請求：Let me guess — recommendation letter? 聽聽大人怎麼接住這個請求。
📋 表格往來：Does the school send you a form? 截止日與連結一次問清。
🕑 細節確認：Tell them I check messages between two and four. 教授的生活習慣也是資訊。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著里歐走進那間辦公室一次，下次換你開口也不緊張。

祝你也遇到那位記得你地圖的老師。
